topline.thesis: Eight sessions called the funnel 'traffic-starved, not code-starved.' Ground-truth says it is BOTH: the named-event conversion funnel (31 data-track-event + 13 data-track-view + 3 funnel-form) has been a gtag no-op since gtag was removed (S147/S175), and 73 pages' primary og:image is an SVG that every social platform renders blank. The studio kept building a parallel RUM beacon next to a dead sink, and shipped its growth on share-cards that don't show. This audit fixes the two silent killers under the apparatus, then makes shares actually convert.

items.title: The entire named-event funnel has been a dead gtag no-op — rewire it to the live /v/rum beacon so 8 sessions of conversion questions finally get answered
items.why: funnel-tracking.js track() emits ONLY through gtag('event', …), but gtag was ripped out site-wide at S147/S175 — so typeof gtag === 'function' is permanently false and every click instrument is discarded. That means all 31 data-track-event CTAs (the S193 hero play-vs-explore split, every membership CTA, the interview funnel), 13 data-track-view exposures, and 3 funnel-form engagements have produced exactly zero data the whole time. It hid in plain sight because a SECOND, working beacon (emitUx → /v/rum) was built right next to it across S186-S192, so the funnel tiles lit up from the RUM path while the named-event path quietly flatlined. Rewire track() to the proven /v/rum transport under a bounded funnel: family and the homepage's own conversion data exists for the first time — directly closing the loop the studio has chased for eight sessions.
items.recipe: In assets/funnel-tracking.js replace the gtag body of track(name, payload) with the membership-unlock.js emitUx pattern: POST {route, ux:'funnel:'+name} to /v/rum via navigator.sendBeacon (keepalive fetch fallback). Add prefixAllowlist('funnel', { maxLen: 48 }) to RUM_UX_DYNAMIC in cloudflare/security-headers-worker.js (one bounded family covers all names, no exact-Set churn — the S192 primitive's exact purpose). Fold funnel:* into rollup-rum-ux.mjs and keep check-rum-allowlist.mjs in sync — emit+allowlist+rollup in ONE change (S189 rule). Also strip the dead <link rel=preconnect/dns-prefetch href=googletagmanager.com> from the propagate-nav head (gtag-removal debris on ~80 pages: wasted TLS setup + privacy-optics smell on a privacy-positioning studio). This SUBSUMES the open HERO-PLAY-VS-EXPLORE-CTR Now item.

L1.recipe: Repoint track() to /v/rum with a finite explicit Set of the ~12 current home_*/interview_*/membership_* names added to RUM_UX_EVENTS; purge the dead googletagmanager preconnect hints. No rollup change.

L2.recipe: Bounded funnel: prefix family in RUM_UX_DYNAMIC + rollup-rum-ux fold + check-rum-allowlist sync + dead-hint purge. Default recipe.

L3.recipe: Also rewire the ambient.shell guarded gtag engagement events (scroll_milestone, exit_intent_shown/answered, ignis_lens_opened, visit_depth_upsell_shown) to the beacon, and surface a 'top funnel events' block in api/funnel-summary.json so /status/ shows which CTA actually converts.

executionLog.result: L2 shipped — funnel-tracking.js rewired gtag→/v/rum under bounded funnel: family; Worker prefixAllowlist; rollup funnelCtas; dead googletagmanager hints purged sitewide (sweep reached skipped pages); worker 25/25, allowlist in sync. Privacy upgrade: internal intent enums no longer leak to Google.

items.title: 73 pages' primary share-card is an SVG that renders blank on every social platform — repoint to the static PNGs that already exist
items.why: The dynamic /_og/ Worker returns image/svg+xml, and its own source comment asserts 'social platforms all rasterize SVG og:image fine' — which is simply false: Facebook, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Discord, Slack and iMessage all reject SVG og:image (SVG can carry script, so it is blocked for security). That false comment is exactly what let it ship. The result: 73 pages serve a primary og:image that shows nothing — 65 are saved on Twitter only because a static twitter:image PNG exists, and 8 are blank everywhere. On a site whose entire growth thesis is 'shared links convert,' every posted VaultSpark link has been arriving as a dead grey rectangle. Twenty-four bespoke PNGs already sit in assets/, so the fix is repointing, not designing — near-zero cost, immediate lift on every share.
items.recipe: Repoint og:image on the 73 pages from the /_og/ SVG to the matching static assets/og-*.png (already used as twitter:image on 65 of them); for the 8 bare pages use assets/og-image.png as the default. Then add scripts/check-og-images.mjs folded into --check (NOT a new build:check segment — chain is near the cmd.exe 8191 limit): fail if any og:image or twitter:image is an SVG, points to a missing asset, or is below 200x200. Keep the /_og/ endpoint for any in-page HTML preview, just stop using it for crawler-facing og:image.

L1.recipe: Repoint only the 65 pages that already carry a static twitter:image PNG so og:image == twitter:image; leaves the 8 bare pages + no gate.

L2.recipe: Cover all 73 incl the 8 bare pages with the og-image.png default + ship check-og-images.mjs gate so a blank SVG card can never silently return. Default recipe.

L3.recipe: Build a zero-dependency build-time pre-rasterizer that renders the /_og/ per-title design to PNG (via a vetted, package-trust-approved pure path) so dynamic per-page cards work AS PNG — keeping the bespoke-per-title win without the SVG break.

executionLog.result: L2 shipped — 73 pages SVG og:image → static PNG (64 twitter-reuse, 2 bespoke football, 7 default); check-og-images.mjs gate (6/6) folded into check-proof-surface (zero build:check length).

items.title: Give every game a one-tap share button — now that the OG card actually renders, each share carries real organic distribution
items.why: The 10 game pages are the studio's only true viral surface — a player who just laughed at Call of Doodie is the cheapest acquisition channel a traffic-starved studio has — yet none of them offer a share affordance. The /oracle/ page already proves the pattern (oracle-share-btn, line 175). This is deliberately sequenced AFTER og-image-raster-fix: a share button that posts a blank card is worse than none, so fixing the card first is what turns each share into a real click-through. Outcome: turn satisfied players into a measured, per-game distribution loop instead of a dead end.
items.recipe: New assets/share-game.js (Web Share API with clipboard-copy fallback, SOUL-voice share text) mounted on the 10 game pages. Allowlist a bounded share:<game>:<outcome> RUM family via the S192 prefixAllowlist primitive + fold into rollup-rum-ux — emit+allowlist+rollup in one change (S189 rule). Idle-load via ambient-loader predicate (path startsWith /games/).

L1.recipe: Single shared share-game.js on call-of-doodie + vaultspark-football-gm (the 2 live titles) with clipboard fallback; one static share: RUM name.

L2.recipe: All 10 game pages + bounded share:<game>:<outcome> family + rollup fold + allowlist sync. Default recipe.

L3.recipe: Add a play-streak hook so the share prompt surfaces after a win/score event with a contextual SOUL-voice line ('You survived 12 waves — dare a friend'), and a per-game share-count tile on the page sourced from funnel-summary.

executionLog.result: L2 shipped — assets/share-game.js (Web Share + clipboard, self-mounting on .game-hero) via ambient-loader predicate; bounded share:<slug>:<outcome> family; rollup shares + worker-unit coverage.

items.title: Lock the door S193 opened: a gate so fabricated review stars can't silently creep back into game schema
items.why: S193 removed a fabricated aggregateRating: 4.5 / ratingCount: 1 from three game pages — a Google structured-data-spam risk and a CANON-008 honesty violation with no review backend behind it. Nothing stops it returning the next time someone hand-edits VideoGame JSON-LD or copies a page as a template. A structural gate converts a one-time cleanup into a permanent guarantee — the studio's proven pattern (proof-feed-generator-gate, rum-allowlist-integrity-gate). Outcome: protects rich-results eligibility and the honesty posture from a silent regression.
items.recipe: scripts/check-videogame-schema.mjs: parse JSON-LD on the 10 VideoGame pages; FAIL if aggregateRating/ratingValue/reviewCount appears without a real, sourced review dataset; WARN on missing honest enrichment (offers.availability, applicationCategory, operatingSystem). Fold the --self-test into an existing --check (no new build:check segment).

L1.recipe: Hard-fail-on-aggregateRating gate + self-test, folded into --check. Default recipe.

L2.recipe: Also assert the honest enrichment fields S193 added are present + that offers.price is '0'/free is truthfully declared, so schema stays both honest AND complete.

L3.recipe: Generalize to a schema-honesty linter across ALL structured-data types (Organization, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage) flagging any claim (rating, award, count) lacking a traceable source feed.

executionLog.result: L1 shipped — check-videogame-schema.mjs (5/5) fails on fabricated aggregateRating across 10 VideoGame pages; confirms S193 cleanup held; folded into check-proof-surface.

items.title: Bucket WHERE the trickle comes from — the one channel number a traffic-starved site has never measured
items.why: Once item #1 makes the funnel beacon actually fire, the highest-value next signal is the referrer channel: search vs social vs direct vs referral. The studio has self-published uptime, LCP and conversion tiles for a funnel of ~1 event/30d but never the single most actionable acquisition fact — which channel works. Bucketed honest-dark into api/funnel-summary.json.sources (domain-classified, never full URL, no PII), it turns 'we have no traffic' into 'channel X is the only one that converts — double it.' Deliberately ranked below #1 because it is measurement-on-measurement: worthless until the sink it rides on is alive.
items.recipe: Confirm document.referrer reaches the /v/rum rollup (analytics.js captures it but the ux beacon does not today). Add a client-classified referrer-family token (search/social/direct/referral — domain-bucketed, never raw URL) to the funnel beacon + a bounded Worker allowlist family + a sources rollup in rollup-rum-ux.mjs → api/funnel-summary.json.sources. Honest-dark below minSamples. All three ends in one change.

L1.recipe: Classify referrer client-side and emit a single bounded source:<bucket> ux event on first page of session; allowlist the family. No rollup tile yet.

L2.recipe: Full sources aggregate in rollup-rum-ux → funnel-summary.json.sources + honest-dark /status/ tile. Default recipe.

L3.recipe: Cross sources x conversion: which channel's visitors reach the membership stage, so the studio learns not just the loudest channel but the highest-intent one.

executionLog.result: L2 shipped — analytics.js classifies referrer → bounded source:<bucket> emit once/session (inherits consent+DNT); Worker family; rollup sources block. Honest-dark until samples.

skipped.reason: Pipeline already live (S192); pure measurement-watch, data-starved — no code action until chip traffic accrues.
Real ops item but infra (hcloud/SSH) not a website-code audit item; tracked on TASK_BOARD, preflight before founder-label.

executionSummary: S194 shipped 5/5. build:check EXIT 0 end-to-end (115-page crawl, 0 failures). Headline: the entire named-event funnel was a dead gtag no-op since S147/S175 — rewired to the live /v/rum beacon, so homepage hero/CTA/interview-funnel data lands for the first time. And 73 pages’ primary og:image was a blank-on-every-platform SVG — repointed to static PNG + permanent gate. Both silent killers sat UNDER the apparatus 8 sessions polished.
